cases.preconditions: One fresh master and 100 fresh followers; B-book Real Hedging; funded with 100,000 staging units.
cases.steps:
1. Start with no follower links.
2. Send fifty follow requests concurrently.
3. Read master follower links and compare all fifty identities.
cases.expected: All fifty followers are linked exactly once.

cases.description: Copy one master BUY to 100 followers
cases.preconditions: One fresh master and 100 fresh followers; B-book Real Hedging; funded with 100,000 staging units.
cases.steps:
1. Link all 100 followers.
2. Submit master EURUSD BUY 0.01.
3. Poll positions on every follower.
4. Verify side, count and quantity.
cases.expected: Each of 100 followers receives one correctly sized BUY copy.
cases.actual: 100/100 followers received one BUY position of 0.01 lot.
